Hi Ananya — thanks for the quick note and for attaching the invoice.

Short answer up front: Redwood does not have an Indian GST registration for the hosted API business line. In most B2B SaaS cases we treat the supply as "import of services" and customers apply local reverse-charge where applicable. That said, we need to confirm the facts on your side (GSTIN, nature of use) before recommending the exact withholding approach.

Could you please send:
1) BlueWave GSTIN / state of registration
2) A short note on whether the services are used in your commercial operations (vs. resale)
3) A copy of your GST certificate (if available) — we can accept a scanned PDF

For audit purposes, if you apply reverse-charge please include an accounting note showing the GST accounted under reverse-charge and attach any self-billing or tax declaration. If you prefer, we can sign a brief self-billing attestation that you can attach to your payment file — Ben is looped to prepare that.

I will also run this past Finance (Ben) to confirm whether Redwood needs to provide any invoice amendment or wording to support reverse-charge.
